name: Porto-Novo
subtitle: Porto-Novo, capital of Benin: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Musée Honmè and Alexandre Adandé Museum safeguard centuries of royal Gun regalia and sacred Yoruba Gèlèdé masks.

gaps: Final analytical data from the 5th general census (RGPH-5) are pending completion by INSAE.
First-hand local voices from master artisans of the Aguda district and Gèlèdé mask carvers are missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
